scope: Ten record review after the full-text extraction expansion
method: Reviewed each legacy record against its matching original content JSON because legacy source_chunk values are empty. The extractor was repaired prospectively to persist the evidence supplied to the LLM; this audit does not modify historical records.
finding: Use experimental records only within the stated composition, processing, and measurement-temperature boundaries. Do not use theoretical values, cited literature values, or high-temperature values as room-temperature route targets.

records.assessment: Partially supported. The source describes F-substituted LPSCl and gives a complete synthesis route, but the extracted record omitted key milling and annealing fields.
records.usable_evidence: Li2S, P2S5, LiCl, and LiF; planetary milling at 510 rpm for 13 h under Ar; sealed tube treatment at 550 C for 5 h.
records.use_constraint: Suitable for an F-substitution process-screening hypothesis, not for a quantified conductivity target from this record.

records.usable_evidence: Li6PS5Cl made by milling and 550 C annealing; pellet-sintered 4 h sample reached 6.11 mS cm-1, while powder-sintered samples were lower.
records.use_constraint: Use for the density and annealing-time optimization direction; retain pellet geometry and sintering route in comparisons.

records.assessment: Supported for Br-rich composition and cooling-control prior art; the extracted conductivity field mixes cited values with the study context.
records.usable_evidence: Li6-xPS5-xBr1+x was mechanically milled at 510 rpm for 25 h and subsequently heat treated; quench versus slow cooling controls disorder. The reviewed source reports a quenched Li5.5PS4.5Br1.5 maximum of 8.55 mS cm-1.
records.use_constraint: Do not claim Br-rich disordering or cooling control is unexplored. Attribute any numerical result to the exact composition and cooling treatment.

records.usable_evidence: The reported 26.6 mS cm-1 value is computational and chlorine substitution is predicted to affect phase behavior.
records.use_constraint: Exclude from experimental performance expectations and synthesis-condition selection.

records.usable_evidence: An ACN/rGO templated liquid-phase route followed by 550 C for 5 h yielded argyrodite material; the stated room-temperature conductivity is 1.54 mS cm-1 and excess rGO creates electronic conduction.
records.use_constraint: Use only as a morphology/template comparison route, not as support for the selected powder-process routes.

records.assessment: Supported baseline synthesis and temperature-resolved performance evidence.
records.usable_evidence: 500 rpm for 24 h followed by 500 C for 2 h in an Ar glovebox; 1.30e-3 S cm-1 at 25 C and 1.05e-2 S cm-1 at 60 C.
records.use_constraint: Keep the 25 C and 60 C measurements separate; do not quote the 60 C value as room-temperature performance.

records.usable_evidence: Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 was mechanically milled and vacuum annealed. The 350 C condition gave 1.2 mS cm-1 and 0.385 eV; the source reports its maximum conductivity after 450 C annealing.
records.use_constraint: Do not transfer the 450 C optimum to other halide-rich compositions without a separate experiment.

records.usable_evidence: Environmental mechanical alloying formed an approximately 50 nm oxysulfide nanolayer on Li6PS5Cl. The source reports initial conductivity of 3.02 mS cm-1 and retention above 2.50 mS cm-1 after 30 min air exposure and slurry-chemical exposure.
records.use_constraint: Do not claim that sulfide/oxide-like protective-shell concepts are absent. This is oxysulfide, not proof for every proposed oxide shell.

records.assessment: Supported composition-space prior art but weak for numerical route parameters in the extracted record.
records.usable_evidence: Li5.5PS4.5ClxBr1.5-x with x=0.4, 0.8, and 1.2 was studied; conductivity peaked near x=0.8 and EIS/NMR disagreement was linked to grain-boundary contact.
records.use_constraint: Do not claim the full Cl/Br-rich composition space is unexplored; use as an optimization benchmark requiring direct source confirmation for numeric values.

records.assessment: Supported cation-doping and grain-boundary evidence with a temperature qualification.
records.usable_evidence: Mechanical milling at 600 rpm for 20 h under dry Ar; Ca-doped material reached 12.9 mS cm-1 at 70 C and YCl3-modified material reached 13 mS cm-1 at 50 C. Dopants concentrate at grain boundaries.
records.use_constraint: Do not present these high-temperature values as room-temperature gains; the source indicates only slight room-temperature improvement.
